dedupe_keys.name: swat modflow coupled watershed groundwater model

description: SWAT+MODFLOW is a coupled hydrological model published by its developers through Zenodo. It connects SWAT+ landscape, channel and reservoir processes with MODFLOW groundwater flow and exchanges with soils, canals, reservoirs and irrigation pumping. Geographic links between watershed objects and groundwater cells are prepared before simulation, with exchanges calculated on a daily step. The archive provides source code, a compiled executable, a Word tutorial and example models for the John Martin Reservoir watershed in Colorado and the Middle San Joaquin–Lower Chowchilla watershed in California. Users can adapt the documented model to other study regions for water-supply and irrigation-management studies. The archive is freely accessible and declares CC BY 4.0; component-level licence files were not inspected. A limitation is the need to prepare consistent coupled inputs and calibrate the model for a new watershed. The examples are published applications, not proof of accuracy everywhere. No directly related catalogue record was established. The multi-gigabyte example archives and executable were not downloaded or run.
